rows.text:
- Independent assessment by subagent migration_plan_review, using the shared authenticated Codex identity; reviewed submitted target revision 556 and candidate v3 from revision 555.
- Accept this high-level plan: positive/negative TypeScript checks, model-compiler compatibility and runtime/persistence rehearsal gate the first live cutover; R1/R2 are addressed in the plan.
- All 11 task descriptions match the pinned candidate and contain four bullets. Four native agent reviews precede the relevant human checkpoints; human decisions remain bounded and practical.
- No remaining planning blocker found. Detailed contracts, affected dependency coverage, code, tests and migration safety remain to be proved at their checkpoints; this outcome does not approve implementation or replace human approval.
